description: Latest week of USDA export sales for one commodity from the FAS Export Sales Reporting (ESR) system — sales contracted by exporters, not yet necessarily shipped. Use for current foreign demand; use get_export_sales_history instead for the weekly trend, and get_trade_flows for actual shipped volumes. Read-only lookup of stored reports; no API key. ESR reports weekly (released Thursdays); returns the most recent stored week's weekly exports, outstanding sales, net sales for the current marketing year, and total commitments per destination country, each row with its reported unit. Omit `country` to include all destinations.

country.description: GENC country code (e.g. CHN, MEX) or omit for all destinations

name: get_export_sales
